release_notes:
Patch Release - UI Refinements, Theme & Documentation.

New Features:
  - Frame Format Diagram: Config Info dialog now shows a graphical byte-aligned on-wire frame layout; hover any field block to see its name, offset, and width.
  - Unsolicited Data Detection: Auto-Fetch polling now detects spontaneous device transmissions and pauses outgoing requests to prevent TX/RX collisions.
  - XY Plot Theming: XY Plotter window now respects the active Light/Dark/System theme for consistent appearance.

Improvements:
  - Plot Layout: Variable-strip widget layout rebuilt with QGridLayout for correct stretching when switching between multi-grid configurations.
  - qdarktheme Integration: Native qdarktheme is now used directly; the compatibility shim has been removed.
  - CSV Alias Normalization: Additional lowercase and concatenated aliases (e.g. framevariables, txcommandfields) are now accepted as valid config filenames.
  - Import/Error Handling: Streamlined module imports and improved error propagation across serial, decoder, and UI layers.

Fixes:
  - Fixed missing FrameConfig import in widgets.py that caused a crash when loading legacy CSV configs.

Documentation:
  - README and in-app manual (index.html) fully updated: Auto-Reconnect back-off table, Frame Format Diagram, Import Schema Mapper, updated Plot Settings (Memory Cap + Display Window), Queue Saturated badge dismiss instructions.
